newsitem.title: UK: UK's CBI sets new release times for key reports.
newsitem.headline: UK's CBI sets new release times for key reports.

text.p: The Confederation of British Industry (CBI) has introduced a new set of release times for most of its major reports, including Thursday's industrial trends survey, a CBI official said on Thursday.
The industrial trends survey will be released at 1000 GMT. Previously this survey was often released at 1030 GMT.
The official said all of the CBI's trends surveys would now be at 1000 GMT, while its distributive trades survey would be released at 0900 GMT.
The official said the CBI for some time had wanted to standardise its release times, partly because of problems with leakages of information contained in some reports.
